rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: AI red team automation framework that wraps 15+ mainstream offensive security tools into standardized MCP interfaces. Integrates Go-based high-performance engines (gogo, fscan, httpx, nuclei, ffuf, dnsx, kerbrute) with Python Active Directory pentest suites (Impacket, NetExec, BloodHound) and Playwright browser automation. Supports autonomous asset discovery, web fingerprinting, vulnerability verification, Kerberoasting, lateral movement, and automated reporting. Includes a bundled SKILL.md knowledge base that guides AI agents on correct parameters and progressive recon workflows across Windows and Linux platforms.
